subject: executor: fix data inconsistency after `load data ... replace into ...` (#56415)
summary: Fixes LOAD DATA ... REPLACE duplicate handling in `InsertValues.batchCheckAndInsert` by propagating `removeRow`’s boolean return: when the duplicated row is byte-identical, the executor now skips reinserting it (instead of proceeding to `addRecord`), avoiding record/index inconsistency for unique-key conflicts such as nonclustered PK. Adds regression test `TestFix56408` (with `ADMIN CHECK TABLE`) and bumps loaddatatest Bazel sharding.
